item.title: LEADING | Is It Already Too Late to Control AI? (Anthropic Co-Founder, Jack Clark)
item.description:
Why is one of AI's most powerful insiders scared of what he's building? Who's really in charge of the technology reshaping our world? Is it too late for governments to regulate it?
Rory and Matt Clifford are joined by Jack Clark, Co-Founder of Anthropic, to answer all these questions and more.

item.title: LEADING | Will AI Give China or the US Total Power? (William MacAskill)
item.description:
Could artificial intelligence hand the US or China 99% of global economic and military power? What happens when millions of autonomous weapons systems are controlled by a single commander-in-chief? Has effective altruism's influence in Silicon Valley accelerated or slowed the race for artificial general intelligence?
Alastair and Rory are joined by William MacAskill to discuss all this and more.

item.title: Who Is Really Running the AI Revolution?
item.description:
Who is Demis Hassabis, and what makes him so extraordinary? Is his story a cautionary tale? And, What does one man's obsession tell us about the forces driving the AI revolution?
Rory Stewart is joined by Sebastian Mallaby, biographer of Demis Hassabis and senior fellow for international economics at the Council on Foreign Relations.

item.title: Will AI End Humanity? | FULL EPISODE
item.description:
If there is even a 1% chance that AI could destroy us, should we keep building it? Are we creating machines that will one day outthink humanity? And is the race to dominate AI accelerating us toward a future we’re unprepared to face?
This week, Yoshua Bengio joins Rory Stewart and Matt Clifford for an AI deep dive. A Turing Award–winning pioneer of deep learning, Bengio helped build the field, and is now one of its most urgent critics, warning that without restraint, the risks ahead could be profound.

item.title: China Vs USA: Who Will Win the AI Race? | FULL EPISODE
item.description:
Who really controls AI; governments, corporations, or no one at all? Is AI becoming a new kind of global arms race? And, can we keep humans in charge of systems that move faster than we do?
Rory and Matt are joined by President of the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace, Mariano-Florentino Cuéllar. Tino is a former justice on the Supreme Court of California, an executive appointee to the Clinton, Obama and Biden administrations and a Professor of Law at Stanford University.

item.title: Will AI Take Our Jobs? | FULL EPISODE
item.description:
Is AI a genuine productivity revolution, or just another tech bubble? Are any jobs safe from the advent of AI? And, can the UK harness the innovation, or will it fall behind?
Rory Stewart is joined by former government advisor of AI, and author of the AI Action Plan, for a members only series on the future of Artificial Intelligence.

item.title: How Will AI Change The World? | FULL EPISODE
item.description:
How will artificial intelligence transform the way we live, work, and shape our lifestyles over the next decade? With investment in AI exploding over the past twelve years, are we witnessing the dawn of a technological gold mine or the inflation of another classic bubble? And why isn’t this revolution attracting the scrutiny it deserves?
Rory Stewart is joined by Matt Clifford former government adviser on AI and author of The AI Action Plan for an exclusive members-only mini-series exploring the real future of artificial intelligence.
